project.name: Golden: buying a small business
project.brief: How to buy a small main-street business (HVAC, services, light manufacturing) in the US using an SBA 7(a) loan: financing structure and down payment rules, how businesses are valued, what due diligence must cover, deal structure (LOI, working capital, seller transition), and what to do in the first 90 days.
project.goal: Decide whether to buy a business in the next 12 months and know the exact financing structure and diligence checklist.
questions: How much money do I need to bring to a deal?

evidence.quote: the SBA requires a minimum ten percent equity injection
half of that ten percent can come from a seller note
debt service coverage ratio of at least one point two five
quality of earnings report costs somewhere between eight and twenty thousand dollars
more than twenty percent of revenue, price that risk in or walk
sixty day exclusivity period in the LOI
